purpose: Define deterministic aggregation of merit evidence from multiple Projects into one subject's registration-anchored weekly reporting interval while preserving per-Project provenance.

topics.purpose: Define deterministic aggregation of merit evidence from multiple Projects into one subject's registration-anchored weekly reporting interval while preserving per-Project provenance.

semantics.subject_rule: Aggregation groups by exact subject identity and weekly interval.
semantics.project_rule: Each contribution keeps exact Project ref.
semantics.sum_rule: Time/points/evidence aggregation follows explicit calculation profile.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Shared/reused evidence is deduplicated according to exact provenance.
semantics.projection_rule: Weekly aggregate is derived and does not replace per-Project evidence.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: Project weeks kept separate from subject cadence
same evidence counted across two Projects
aggregate grants Tier automatically outside policy

references.purpose: Aggregation uses exact identity weekly cadence.
